subtitle: Master the seven modes of the major scale and unlock new dimensions of musical expression
heroDescription: Modes are variations of the major scale that create distinct musical colors and emotional qualities. Each mode starts from a different degree of the major scale, producing unique interval patterns that define genres, create atmosphere, and expand your improvisational vocabulary beyond basic major and minor scales.

whatAreModes.title: What Are Musical Modes?
whatAreModes.description: Modes are different starting points within the same set of notes, creating unique interval relationships and characteristic sounds. All seven modes use the same notes as their parent major scale, but each mode emphasizes different tonal centers and creates distinct musical personalities:

modeCategories.name: Major Character
modeCategories.description: Modes with major third intervals that create bright, uplifting sounds.

modeCategories.name: Minor Character
modeCategories.description: Modes with minor third intervals that create darker, more introspective sounds.

modeCategories.name: Jazz Favorites
modeCategories.description: Most commonly used modes in jazz improvisation and composition.

modeCategories.name: Rock & Blues
modeCategories.description: Essential modes for rock, blues, and contemporary guitar styles.

modalApplications.title: Modal Improvisation
modalApplications.description: Each mode creates distinctive improvisational flavors and moods

modalApplications.title: Chord Progressions
modalApplications.description: Modes determine characteristic chord progressions and harmonic movement

modalApplications.title: Genre Definition
modalApplications.description: Different modes define the characteristic sounds of musical genres

modalApplications.title: Emotional Expression
modalApplications.description: Modes provide specific emotional colors and atmospheric qualities

modeTypes.name: Ionian (Major)
modeTypes.description: The foundation mode - bright, happy, and optimistic. The standard major scale.

modeTypes.name: Dorian
modeTypes.description: Minor with a twist - sophisticated and jazzy. Raised 6th gives it brightness.

modeTypes.name: Phrygian
modeTypes.description: Exotic and Spanish flavored. The flat 2nd creates distinctive Mediterranean sound.

modeTypes.name: Lydian
modeTypes.description: Dreamy and ethereal. The raised 4th creates a floating, magical quality.

modeTypes.name: Mixolydian
modeTypes.description: Bluesy and dominant. Major scale with flat 7th - perfect for rock and blues.

modeTypes.name: Aeolian (Natural Minor)
modeTypes.description: The natural minor scale - emotional, melancholic, and deeply expressive.

modeTypes.name: Locrian
modeTypes.description: Unstable and dissonant. Rare but creates unique tension with flat 2nd and 5th.

journeySection.title: Start Your Modal Journey
journeySection.description: Begin with the most practical and commonly used modes, then expand to explore more exotic sounds. Understanding modes opens up new worlds of musical expression and improvisational possibilities.

links.title: Start with Dorian
links.description: The most practical mode - sophisticated minor sound with jazzy brightness.

links.title: Master Mixolydian
links.description: Essential for rock and blues - major scale with bluesy flat 7th.

links.title: Explore Lydian
links.description: Create dreamy, floating atmospheres with the magical raised 4th.
